title: IT Cloud Web Application Platform Engineer
description: WEC Business Services LLC, a subsidiary of WEC Energy Group, is seeking an IT Cloud Web Application Platform Engineer in Milwaukee, Pewaukee, or Green Bay, Wisconsin. The Infrastructure Consultant on the Cloud Platform team builds and maintains cloud infrastructure for the corporation, carries operational and strategic responsibilities, and collaborates with development teams to deploy and maintain cloud-based applications and services. This position currently offers flexibility for a hybrid work arrangement (remote/on-site) with time regularly spent in the office. WEC Energy Group is a Fortune 500 electric generation and distribution and natural gas delivery holding company serving 4.7 million customers across the Midwest. The company offers competitive pay and benefits and emphasizes safety, well-being, employee development, and a diverse and inclusive workforce.
experience: This position is part of a job family (Infrastructure Consultant and Senior Infrastructure Consultant) where experience will be the determining factor.
salary: $78,702.26–$135,761.08. The pay range reflects the minimum and maximum for the position at the time of posting and may be modified in the future. The starting salary/pay within the pay range will be based on several factors, as applicable, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, travel requirements, collective bargaining agreements, and business and organizational needs. At WEC Energy Group, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role.
responsibilities: Provision platform as a service and application based services in the cloud.
Collaborate with development teams for cloud based application hosting.
Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for managing and provisioning cloud based resources.
Maintain and govern library for IaC shared modules.
Collaborate with on-premise infrastructure teams to align infrastructure standards.
Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis for cloud infrastructure.
Participate in a 24x7 on-call support role on a rotating basis.
qualifications: Minimum: 2+ years of IT infrastructure experience.
Preferred: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems or a related field.
Preferred: 2+ years of Azure and/or AWS development experience.
Preferred: Azure, AWS, Azure DevOps, Terraform IaC, FinOps, CI/CD Pipelines, or CNAPP experience.
Preferred: Azure Front Door, AWS ALB, Web Hosting, or WAF experience.
Preferred: Production support experience with large enterprise applications.

WEC Energy Group will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 with OPT or CPT, H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.
